about.title: About Us
about.oneLiner: Using narrative, visual, sound, and interaction as media, creating digital content experiences that transcend time and resonate continuously.
about.intro: Permafrost Echo is an innovative company focused on future narrative, digital content, and immersive experiences. We use "permafrost" to symbolize time, memory, and deep structures, and "echo" to represent sound, feedback, and continuous dissemination — transforming cold, expansive imagination into perceptible, interactive, and memorable content experiences.
about.intro2: The company focuses on the intersection of technology, art, and humanities. Through creative planning, visual design, interactive experiences, audio narrative, and digital production, we provide distinctive content solutions for brands, institutions, and cultural projects. Permafrost Echo believes that truly vital works don't just stay in a moment of viewing, but form lasting echoes in the hearts of audiences.

philosophy.title: Brand Philosophy
philosophy.content: Beneath the permafrost lie traces sealed by time; within the echo, the dialogue between people and the world continues. The name Permafrost Echo expresses the company's focus on depth, memory, environment, sound, and a sense of the future. We aim to make complex issues understandable, give shape to abstract concepts, and endow brand expressions with lasting penetration through restrained, precise, and emotionally charged creative approaches.

advantage.title: Core Advantages
advantage.content: Permafrost Echo emphasizes both conceptual depth and execution precision. We value problem definition in early-stage strategy as much as the textural details in final presentation. Through interdisciplinary collaboration, the team integrates text, imagery, sound, space, and interaction mechanisms into unified experiences.
advantage.point1: Establish memory anchors through narrative, giving brands and projects core expressions that can be retold
advantage.point2: Enhance perception through design, creating consistent experiences across visual, sound, and interaction
advantage.point3: Expand boundaries through technology, evolving content from static display to dynamic connection and long-term operation

mission.title: Mission
mission.item1: Promote collaboration among game developers in the region through Game Jams, workshops, exhibitions, and other formats
mission.item2: Build bridges between universities and industry, supporting the growth of young development teams
mission.item3: Promote the international dissemination of Northeast Asia indie game culture

origin.title: Name Origin
origin.content: "Permafrost Echo" symbolizes the undying voice from the frozen land. On this northern ground covered by winter snow, we listen to the heartbeat and echoes of every creator.

vision.title: Vision
vision.content: Build the most cohesive indie game creation network in Northeast Asia, enabling developers, artists, and scholars to share creativity and resources across borders.

founder.title: Founder
founder.name: Yan Si
founder.education: Ph.D. in Finance, Dongbei University of Finance and Economics · MBA, San Francisco State University
founder.bio: Years of experience in the game industry, dedicated to promoting the development of the Northeast Asia indie game ecosystem. Believes in the potential of regional game creators, with connection and empowerment as the core mission.

brand.title: Brand Visual Identity
brand.theme: Deep Night Permafrost · Aurora Tech · Northeast Industrial Aesthetics
brand.description: Our visual style blends the heavy strength of Northeast industrial aesthetics with the tech feel of aurora glaciers — dark permafrost as the base, ice blue as the primary color, aurora purple for gradients, and warm orange for human warmth.
